  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">Rooms</h1></div>

    <div
      class="content"
    >
      <div data-fluid-engine="true"><style></style><div class="fluid-engine fe-685510fa826dbc45446d4686"><div class="fe-block fe-block-yui_3_17_2_1_1750398936479_8080"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/3aa5b488-3c8c-4ec8-9df6-00b4a3aa7551_975/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1750398936479_8080" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1750398936479_8080"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Rooms Designed for Calm, Comfort &amp; Caribbean Simplicity</strong></h2><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Welcome to Roatán’s quiet East End, a part of the island where the beach is uncrowded, the breeze is gentle, and the days move at an easy, natural pace. Camp Bay Lodge sits right on this shoreline, surrounded by white coral sand, turquoise water, palm trees, and wide-open views.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our rooms are built with natural hardwoods and simple island architecture that blends seamlessly with the landscape. Each one is just a few steps from the sea, offering fresh air, soft light, and a relaxed atmosphere that makes it easy to unwind.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Inside, you’ll find everything you need for a comfortable stay:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Quality beds</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Private bathrooms</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Ceiling fans &amp; window screens</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Refrigerator</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Fiber-optic WiFi &nbsp;</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Air-conditioning</strong></p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Select rooms include a fully equipped kitchenette</strong></p></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Breakfast is included in every room rate, served daily at our beachfront restaurant.<br> (Please note: Government tax of 19% is not included.)</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Whether you’re here to rest, explore, dive, kite, or enjoy slow Caribbean days, our rooms are designed to be a calm and comfortable home base, with nature providing the rest.</p></div>
